stops.name: Jostedalsbreen
stops.quote: Im Nationalpark liegt der Jostedalsbreen, welcher der größte Gletscher des europäischen Festlandes ist.
stops.english: The Jostedalsbreen is located in the national park, which is the largest glacier on the European mainland.

stops.name: Høgste Breakulen
stops.quote: Die höchsten Berge im Nationalpark sind der Høgste Breakulen (1.952 moh.) und der Lodalskåpa (2.083 moh.).
stops.english: The highest mountains in the national park are the Høgste Breakulen (1,952 m above sea level) and the Lodalskåpa (2,083 m above sea level).

stops.name: Lodalskåpa

stops.english: The highest mountains in the national park are the Høgste Breakulen (1,952 m above sea level) and the Lodalskåpa (2,083 m above sea level).

stops.name: Flatbrehytta
stops.quote: Neben zahlreichen Wanderwegen im Nationalpark gibt es auch noch die Touristenhütten Flatbrehytta, Bødalssetra und Vetledalssetra.
stops.english: In addition to numerous hiking trails in the national park, there are also the tourist huts Flatbrehytta, Bødalssetra and Vetledalssetra.

stops.name: Breheimsenteret
stops.quote: Es gibt drei Museen im Nationalpark: das Breheimsenteret in Jostedalen bei Gaupne das Jostedalsbreen Nasjonalparksenter in Stryn und das Norsk Bremuseum in Fjærland.
stops.english: There are three museums in the national park: the Breheimsenteret in Jostedalen near Gaupne, the Jostedalsbreen Nasjonalparksenter in Stryn and the Norsk Bremuseum in Fjærland.
